name: footer-minimal
title: Footer Minimal
description: A single-row footer with brand and copyright, a few links and social icons that lift on hover.

props.name: brand
props.description: Logo or wordmark at the start.

props.name: copyright
props.description: Short text next to the brand.

props.name: social
props.type: { label: string; href: string; icon: ReactNode }[]
props.description: Icon links at the end. The label names each link.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the hover lift on social icons off.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
